'''T'var'k''' was the second [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Nagi Prime]] in the [[Nagi system/Legends|Nagi system]]. Located in the satellite galaxy [[Firefist]] beyond the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], it was a hothouse world.
